The lighting is even and bright from overhead industrial fixtures. A store employee in a green uniform is seen in the distance between aisles. (4) Close-ups of rolled-up T-shirts in wire bins are shown, in colors like green, pink, black, and white. (6) The man returns to the store setting, carrying a large blue IKEA shopping bag, gesturing towards the surrounding home furnishing sections while smiling broadly at the camera.
